name: Question-led H1–H3 heading hierarchy & content briefs
intro: Build logical H1, H2, and H3 outlines around real reader sub-questions and competitor gaps without stuffing the primary keyword into every heading.

name: Answer-first introductions, TL;DR boxes & jump-link TOCs
intro: Eliminate fluffy 200-word throat-clearing intros. Answer the core query in paragraph one, frame who the page is for, and build crawl-safe jump-link Table of Contents.

name: 45-word Featured Snippets, People Also Ask & comparison tables
intro: Write self-contained 40-to-55 word definition passages, ordered process lists, and HTML/Markdown comparison tables immediately underneath question-based H2 headings.

name: E-E-A-T first-hand proof, Information Gain & citation weaving
intro: Differentiate your article from consensus AI summaries by weaving in first-hand test notes, quantitative benchmarks, edge-case caveats, and primary source citations.

name: Plain-English readability editing, sentence cadence & de-fluffing
intro: Revise dense, academic, or robotic paragraphs for Grade 7–9 clarity while strictly preserving technical accuracy, legal/clinical caveats, and author voice.

name: Semantic coverage, competitor sub-topic gaps & entity depth
intro: Compare your draft against top-ranking outlines to spot missing sub-topics, unanswered reader edge cases, and natural domain terminology without 'LSI' keyword stuffing.

name: Internal link anchor bridges, image Alt Text & visual callouts
intro: Write natural contextual bridge sentences for internal links, descriptive screen-reader & SEO image Alt Text, and inline infographic or chart callout boxes.
toolName: AI Image Alt Text & Accessibility Studio

name: Content decay refreshes, historical updates & pre-publish QA
intro: Audit decaying articles for outdated claims, merge thin overlapping sections, update year-specific examples responsibly, and run a final pre-publish fact & SEO check.
